Recto, bottom margin

  1. Yaʿqūb al-Maghribī, 6. The apprentice of (the) Maghribī, 10. The cripple, 15. The poor, for Pesaḥ, 16½;
  2. balance, 20 dir.; R. Yeḥī(ʾēl), 70, (for) poll tax, and one silver dirhem
  3. that I paid to al-Rāṣūy
  4. for the son of the widow of al-Dimashqī, 4.
  5. (5-8) That is the balance of the collection of Faḍāʾil. Owed by al-Saʿīd, (being) the balance from the repairs of the Synagogue, 16. It exceeded the price of 50 dir. (by) 5 (dir.). To the foreigners, paid by al-Rāṣūy, al-Shaykh Abū Isḥaq b. Abūʾl-Rabīʿ, and myself, 40. David al-Rūmī 4 who is with R ....., 40.
  6.  
  7.

  1. Joseph b. AkhūʾI-Jayyid.

  1. The apartment of Abraham aI-Sōfēr
  2. b. R. Samuel al-Darʿī,
  3. The qāʿa that is near
  4. the bāb sirr of the (Synagogue of the) Palestinians,
  5. from 7 Tammuz of the year 1524
  6. for 6 dir. A month.

  1. (1-4) I collected from al-Shaykh Abūʾl-Khayr, the son of the wife of Saadya (for the) masons, 3¼. Ḥikr for Ṣafar, in copper, 30. Nightwatch, 1½, 8.

  11. (11-17) 4. The balance to his credit, 11⅛. Paid to him by Maḥāsin al-Nashāwī, 5. The balance to his credit, 6½ ⅛. Owed by him, 1 dir. nuqra. Yaʿqūb Gharīb, a tip, 3.
